## Context
The DSO ticket system has accumulated 113 non-closed orphan story/task tickets (16 stories + 97 tasks) because skill files and sub-agent dispatch prompts do not reliably thread parent_id through ticket create calls. The 2026-05-12 audit reports a 1/5 health score with 106 warnings dominated by "orphan ticket: no epic parent". DSO maintainers cannot trust dependency graphs, sprint scoping, or epic completion semantics. Sprint orchestrators and sub-agents that consume the dependency graph to scope work and determine epic completion are also impaired — incorrect parent linkage causes misordered batches and premature epic closure. Hard-fail at ticket creation is rejected — capturing ticket data must take precedence over enforcing structure — so remediation is primarily structural: the orchestrator writes a literal --parent=<id> at every ticket create story|task call site (including literal injection into sub-agent dispatch prompts before dispatch), and a CI test enforces this structurally by scanning every SKILL.md and dispatch prompt. The existing bug-template enforcement pattern at ticket-create.sh lines 279-328 is retained as a backstop — the CLI exits 0 and emits a structured stderr ERROR with explicit "To fix:" command — with the stderr-capture+ticket edit --parent remediation snippet applied only at the orchestrator-context shell sites where bash stderr capture is reliable. The standalone ticket tag marks tickets that intentionally have no parent; standalone-tagged tickets are excluded from orphan warnings.

## Success Criteria
- validate-issues.sh --quick --terse reports 0 orphan story/task warnings AND no non-closed story/task in the live tracker has parent_id=null, EXCLUDING tickets tagged standalone (intentional opt-out) and tickets tagged defer or dso-cleanup-pending (owned by 7271-e463). Before/after diff produced inside the sprint session by running validate-issues.sh --quick --terse immediately after orphan-cleanup.sh completes.
- ticket-create.sh emits "ERROR: <type> ticket <id> created without --parent" to stderr followed by "To fix: ticket edit <id> --parent=<parent-id>" whenever a non-bug, non-standalone-tagged ticket is created without --parent; exit code remains 0 (shell unit test).
- ticket-link.sh retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff (configurable via ticket_link.retry_base_ms=250 and ticket_link.retry_max_ms=2000 with documented defaults), appends a structured JSON entry to the tracker link-failures log on persistent failure (fallback to ${REPO_ROOT}/.dso/link-failures.log when the tracker directory is absent), and emits structured ERROR to stderr (shell unit test).
- PRIMARY (load-bearing): A CI test under plugins/dso/tests/ scans every SKILL.md under plugins/dso/skills/ AND every agent dispatch prompt under plugins/dso/agents/ for ticket create story|task invocations and fails the build when any such invocation does not include an inline --parent= argument in the same command. All flagged sites are remediated within this epic's scope (not deferred). Three pre-existing missing-parent example sites are explicitly remediated: interface-contracts SKILL.md lines 82-87, tickets-health SKILL.md lines 113 and 116, preplanning/prompts/ui-designer-dispatch-protocol.md line 298.
- BACKSTOP: Every orchestrator-context shell block calling ticket create story|task captures stderr via mktemp and runs ticket edit <id> --parent=<id> when "created without --parent" signal observed. Applied only at sites where literal-parent injection at the call site is unreliable (orchestrator constructs parent ID dynamically from session state); site list finalized in preplanning.


## Operational Constraints (Architecture-vs-Evidence Audit Remediation, 2026-05-16)

### State Lifecycle Owner Block (Probe-3 remediation)

| Variable | CREATE | UPDATE | CONSUME | RETIRE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket_link.retry_base_ms` (default 250) | `/dso:onboarding` / dso-config.conf template | Operator edit | ticket-link.sh exponential-backoff loop | N/A — persistent config |
| `ticket_link.retry_max_ms` (default 2000) | Same | Same | Same | N/A — persistent |
| `.dso/link-failures.log` (structured JSON, fallback path) | ticket-link.sh on first persistent failure (mkdir -p + append) | Append-only per failure | Human review; debug-everything for `link-failures` pattern | Rotation: operator manual. Log grows until operator archives/deletes; recommended trigger: >1000 entries OR >1 MiB → archive via `mv .dso/link-failures.log .dso/link-failures-$(date +%Y%m%d).log`. No auto-rotation in v1. |
| `dso-cleanup-pending` tag | orphan-cleanup.sh opus residual step (Step 5) | Stable (no in-place mutation) | 7271-e463 future epic (residual handoff target); validate-issues.sh exclusion | Removed by 7271-e463 worker after processing — explicit untag via `dso ticket untag <id> dso-cleanup-pending` once the residual has been resolved (reparented, retyped, or closed). Closes the audit's named gap. |
| `standalone` tag | Author at ticket creation (intentional opt-out) | Stable | validate-issues.sh exclusion from orphan warnings | Operator untag when the ticket gains a real parent OR closes; manual lifecycle |
| `orphan-cleanup.lock` (flock target in tracker dir) | orphan-cleanup.sh acquires at start | Held for run duration | The script itself (concurrency guard) | Released automatically on script exit (normal or crash); stale lock detection via flock timeout or PID check at next invocation |

Verification (in-session, at sprint Phase I):
- `grep -E '^ticket_link\.retry_' .claude/dso-config.conf` shows both keys with defaults documented.
- `test -d "$(dirname .dso/link-failures.log)" || mkdir -p .dso` runs cleanly (path creation handled).
- `.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --has-tag=dso-cleanup-pending --format=llm | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))"` — value recorded as sprint baseline for the 7271-e463 handoff.
- The 7271-e463 ticket carries an explicit comment referencing this RETIRE contract (untag once processed).
## Dependencies
- 5efb-06ea (blocker) — provides the ticket reparent primitive used by the retro cleanup pipeline and (when stderr-capture backstop fires) by the remediation snippet
- Relates to 7271-e463 (/dso:cleanup skill) — orphan partition boundary: 7271-e463 owns defer/dso-cleanup-pending-tagged orphans; this epic owns all others; RESIDUAL handoff via dso-cleanup-pending tag
- Relates to 83e2-04ae (Jira bridge parent sync) — re-parenting from the cleanup pipeline must be visible to the bridge
- Relates to af26-dd5a (load-bearing HARD-GATEs in same SKILL.md files) — coordinate edit order; CI grep test accepts gate-added invocations with --parent
- Relates to b36c-3e66 (worktree-isolation guard in 44 implementer agents) — canonical dispatch prompt slot order: SUB_AGENT_ROOT guard first, then parent ID injection

## Approach
Mirror the bug-template enforcement pattern (ticket-create.sh lines 279-328) for parent_id on story/task, but with the load-bearing enforcement moved from runtime stderr-capture (per bot-psychologist behavioral review: unreliable at 13 mixed-context sites) to a static CI grep test that asserts every ticket create story|task invocation in SKILL.md and dispatch prompts includes an inline --parent= argument. The CLI stderr ERROR is retained as a backstop signal with skill-side capture+remediate applied only at orchestrator-context shell sites where bash stderr capture is reliable. orphan-cleanup.sh implements a 5-step retro pipeline (explicit-ID reparent / bug retype / test-fixture close / duplicate close / opus batch-of-10) over all live orphans at execution time using the ticket reparent primitive from 5efb-06ea, with flock concurrency guard, capability probe for 5efb-06ea, re-query between steps, and dso-cleanup-pending tagging of residuals for handoff to 7271-e463.

## Scenario Analysis
- Concurrent orphan-cleanup.sh runs produce duplicate reparent operations (high, runtime) — addressed by flock guard
- Opus batch dispatched against stale orphan snapshot (high, runtime) — addressed by re-query before each step
- stderr capture silently drops signal on non-zero sub-process exit (high, runtime) — backstop scope limited to orchestrator shell sites
- 5efb-06ea reparent primitive not merged when orphan-cleanup.sh executes (critical, deployment) — capability probe at startup
- Tracker directory not checked out in working tree (high, deployment) — fallback to .dso/link-failures.log
- standalone tag undefined (medium, configuration) — defined in Context and pipeline skips
- Exponential backoff defaults undocumented (medium, configuration) — config keys with explicit defaults
- Assumption: shell context applies to all 13 sites (critical, assumption) — addressed by R2 redesign: primary enforcement is structural literal injection
- Assumption: PARENT_TICKET_ID always known at sub-agent dispatch time (high, assumption) — addressed by R5 (literal parent ID injection by orchestrator before dispatch)
- Assumption: all 113 orphans have recoverable parent mappings (high, assumption) — addressed by RESIDUAL reporting and dso-cleanup-pending handoff
- Assumption: validate-issues.sh orphan definition matches ticket-create.sh enforcement (medium, assumption) — preplanning task to verify alignment of the two definitions


## Closure Checks

- orphan-cleanup.sh runs the 5-step pipeline over all live orphans at execution time and exits 0 with a summary report counting each remediation type: (1) explicit-ID reparent using ticket reparent from 5efb-06ea, (2) bug retype via ticket edit --ticket_type, (3) test-fixture close, (4) duplicate-of-non-orphan close, (5) opus sub-agent batch-of-10 recommendation+execution. The script (a) acquires an exclusive flock on a tracker-side orphan-cleanup.lock to prevent concurrent invocations; (b) probes for the ticket reparent subcommand at startup and exits with a clear error if 5efb-06ea is not yet merged; (c) re-queries the live orphan list before each step rather than using the snapshot from step 1; (d) skips tickets tagged defer, dso-cleanup-pending, or standalone; (e) opus residuals (no confident parent) are tagged dso-cleanup-pending for handoff to 7271-e463 and reported under "RESIDUAL" in the summary rather than auto-closed.
- **SC (self-use, Probe-1 remediation, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16):** During the 7510 sprint, the new CI grep test (scanning `plugins/dso/skills/` and `plugins/dso/agents/` for ticket-create-without-`--parent`) is active and fires on at least one sprint PR (synthetic or organic). Verification (in-session, at sprint Phase I): `gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --branch=<sprint-branch> --json conclusion,jobs | jq '.[].jobs[] | select(.name | test("orphan|parent"))'` shows the job ran; the three pre-existing missing-parent sites enumerated in the primary SC (interface-contracts:82-87, tickets-health:113/116, ui-designer-dispatch-protocol:298) are confirmed remediated by `grep -nE 'ticket create story|ticket create task' <those files> | grep -v -- '--parent='` returning 0 results.
